# Take a photo. Get a market-accurate quote.

The AI Estimator analyzes your property photos, studies pricing in your local market, and builds a complete line-itemed estimate — with upsells — in minutes. Included on every QuoteIQ plan, across 50+ home service trades.

The QuoteIQ AI Estimator turns property photos and a short job description into a complete, market-accurate estimate. Upload up to 5 photos, type or speak the job, answer a few dynamic questions, and the AI builds the quote from your own service catalog — with upsell recommendations and an optional Before/After AI preview image attached. It works for HVAC, lawn care, roofing, painting, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, and 40+ more trades.

It’s one piece of QuoteIQ’s full AI suite: AI Autopilot (a conversational assistant that runs your whole CRM through 35 tools), AI CoPilot (edits the estimate or invoice you’re already in — “add lawn care, $150, apply 10% off”), the Virtual Call Team (24/7 AI phone answering), Before/After AI, and AI Text Generation in ClientHub. Every one of them ships on every plan, powered by monthly IQ Credits — from 500 credits on Essentials ($29.99/mo) to 8,000 on Max.

Manual quoting takes 20–34 minutes per estimate; the AI Estimator takes 4–7. According to Invoca, leads contacted within 5 minutes convert 21× more often than leads contacted after 30 — speed is the whole game, and neither Jobber nor Housecall Pro offers photo-to-quote AI estimating at any tier.

## Stop asking Facebook groups what to charge.

The biggest question in every contractor group is the same: “How much should I charge for this?” The answers are all over the map because every market is different. What a painter gets in Atlanta isn’t what a painter gets in rural Texas.

The AI Estimator answers it for your zip code. It analyzes your photos for size, surface condition, and access issues, studies pricing data for your specific market, and prices line items from your own QuoteIQ service catalog — so the quote reflects your actual rates, calibrated to local reality.

A real-time Description Score (Poor → Fair → Good) tells you when the AI has enough detail, and voice input means you can dictate the whole job while walking the property.

Quick Answer

 The QuoteIQ AI Estimator is an AI tool that generates complete, market-accurate estimates for home service contractors from property photos and a short job description — in 4–7 minutes instead of the 20–34 minutes manual quoting takes. 

 Upload up to 5 photos, describe the job by typing or voice, and the AI analyzes property size, surface condition, and scope, studies pricing data for your geographic market, asks dynamic follow-up questions specific to the job type, and builds the estimate from your own service catalog. It then recommends upsells, generates an optional Before/After AI preview image, and hands off to automated text and email follow-up after you send. The AI Estimator is part of QuoteIQ’s broader AI suite — AI Autopilot (controls the entire CRM through 35 conversational tools), AI CoPilot (edits estimates and invoices through chat or voice), the Virtual Call Team (24/7 AI call answering), and AI Text Generation — all included on every QuoteIQ plan from $29.99/month via monthly IQ Credits, with no AI add-on packages to buy. By comparison, Jobber ($39/mo entry) and Housecall Pro ($59/mo entry, annual billing) offer advisory AI assistants but no photo-to-quote AI estimating at any tier, and Jobber’s AI Receptionist is a $99/month add-on. Speed matters: Invoca research shows leads contacted within 5 minutes convert 21× more often than leads contacted after 30 minutes. 

## From photo to signed estimate in 8 guided steps.

The AI Estimator runs a guided flow that captures everything needed for an accurate quote — then hands the finished estimate to the rest of QuoteIQ to get it signed, scheduled, and paid.

1

### Upload property photos

Up to 5 photos per estimate. The AI reads property size, surface condition, obstacles, and access issues — a photo of a “heavily stained driveway” shows it exactly what heavily stained means. Photos are optional, but they make pricing noticeably more accurate. Snap them with QuoteIQ Cam.

2

### Describe the job — type or voice

Write it naturally or tap the Voice button and dictate while you walk the property. A real-time Description Score (Poor / Fair / Good) shows whether the AI has enough detail — and exactly how much more it needs.

3

### AI analyzes your market

The AI studies pricing data specific to your geographic location — not national averages. What contractors charge in Phoenix is different from Boston is different from rural Texas, and your estimate reflects that.

4

### Answer dynamic questions

No generic 50-field form. The AI generates targeted questions for this specific job — stories and siding material for a house wash, square footage and stain severity for a driveway, panel age for an electrical quote.

5

### AI builds the estimate

Line items, quantities, descriptions, and pricing — pulled from your own QuoteIQ service catalog so the quote reflects your actual rates, not someone else’s.

6

### Review, adjust, add upsells

You stay in control — edit anything. The AI also recommends logical add-ons (quoting a house wash? It might suggest gutter brightening or window cleaning), each priced from your photos and market data. Adding one takes a tap.

7

### Generate a Before/After preview

Attach an AI-generated Before/After image built from the customer’s actual property photo — not stock imagery — so they can see the transformation before they sign.

8

### Send — QuoteIQ follows up

Send by text, email, or shareable link. Estimate Automations chase the lead by text and email on a schedule you control, and accepted estimates flow into Pipelines and InstaSchedule.

Every lead has a price tag. Your Customer Acquisition Cost is your marketing spend divided by new customers — so every quote request that goes unanswered is paid advertising wasted. The SBA puts disciplined cost tracking among the core habits of service businesses that survive past year five. Faster quoting and automated follow-up are how that CAC number comes down.

## Manual quoting vs. AI Estimator.

For a contractor sending 10 estimates a week, the difference below adds up to 15–20+ hours saved every month — time that goes back into paying jobs.

Manual quoting

20–34 min

Review the job request 2–3 min

Research market pricing 5–10 min

Assess the property 3–5 min

Calculate quantities 3–5 min

Build the estimate line by line 5–8 min

Format and proofread 2–3 min

AI Estimator

4–7 min

Upload photos 30 sec

Describe the job (type or voice) 1–2 min

Answer the AI’s questions 1–2 min

Review and add upsells 1–2 min

Generate Before/After preview 30 sec

Do the labor math. If you bill $75/hour and spend 25 minutes manually building each estimate, that’s roughly $31 of your time per quote before you’ve earned a dollar. The AI Estimator compresses the same work into a few minutes — and because IQ Credits are already included in every plan, there’s no separate AI bill to justify.
